_meta.description: Line 9's stations in order from Dahisar (E) to Subhash Chandra Bose Stadium, as MMRDA's Line 9 and 7A page lists them. 'phase' is the order of opening: 1 Phase I, Dahisar (E) to Kashigaon (open 7 Apr 2026, MMRDA); 2 the rest, Kashigaon to Subhash Chandra Bose Stadium, under construction (Phase II in the news; MMRDA names only Phase I). 'kml_name' is the station's point in MMRDA's alignment file, where three stations still have older names. Positions and along_m come from scripts/build-alignment-line9.py. Names follow MMRDA's English list, except where 'context' says; name_mr its Marathi page.

location.method: MMRDA alignment file for Line 9 (KML on the Metro Influence Zone page, uploaded March 2025): point "Dahisar(E) (M) Station". along_m is measured along a centre line derived from MMRDA's corridor polygon, from Dahisar (E) station; the point is 4 m from that line.

interchanges.notes: Free Press Journal (7 Apr 2026): Dahisar East serves Lines 7, 9 and 2A. MMRDA's page names Lines 2A and 7 as the connections of Lines 9 and 7A. Rohan Shanbhag's interchange table agrees (Red and Yellow lines at Dahisar East).

context.text: MMRDA's English list calls it Dahisar; the site adds (E), as the news and MMRDA's alignment file do. Line 9 begins here, at the north end of Line 7.
Trains run through from Gundavali on Line 7 to Kashigaon; for Line 2A, change here.

construction_status.notes: MMRDA publishes progress for the whole line, not by station (U-girder erection 98% on the viaduct, T-girder erection 97% at the stations, as of 31 Aug 2026). Power on from 29 Jul 2026 (Free Press Journal). Reported for December 2026, after the safety commissioner's inspection. Civil package CA-48 (J Kumar Infraprojects).

context.text: The end of the line, in Bhayandar (W). Near it the line crosses the Western Railway on a 65 m steel girder (June 2025), on a double-decker stretch that shares its viaduct with a road flyover.
News reports also call it Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose Udyan.
